title: Building muscle isn’t just about lifting heavier. 💪
hook: Building muscle isn’t just about lifting heavier. 💪
caption:
Building muscle isn’t just about lifting heavier. 💪
If you want to maximize your muscle growth, focus on these 3 fundamentals:
1️⃣ Progressive overload — Give your muscles a reason to adapt by gradually increasing reps, load, or training quality.
2️⃣ Enough protein — Consistent protein intake supports muscle repair and growth. 🍗🥚
3️⃣ Quality recovery — Training is the stimulus. Recovery is where your body adapts. 😴
Stop chasing complicated hacks. Master the basics and stay consistent.
Save this post for your next workout and share it with someone who’s serious about getting stronger. 🔥
